items.excerpt: Nvidia ACE, the tech behind PUBG's generative-AI team mates, is coming to creature-collecting RPG Aniimo in early 2027, letting players talk to creatures driven by a locally-run Nemotron small language model.
NVIDIA's Gamescom 2026 roundup ships DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction and details how ACE autonomous characters and neural rendering features land in shipping games.
Nvidia used Gamescom to detail a wave of developer-facing updates across DLSS, ray-traced Nanite, RTX and GeForce Now — neural rendering moving from demo to production pipeline.
NVIDIA brings the next wave of RTX gaming to Gamescom, with publishers adopting new AI-accelerated visual quality and anti-cheat technology on RTX Spark hardware.
Humankind 2's reveal trailer was immediately accused of using generative AI for its live-action shots; the developer confirmed no AI was used, showing how AI suspicion now shapes reveal-art craft.

A retro re-release's cover art and trailer carry obvious generative-AI tells while the publisher insists 'no generative AI was used' — a case study in how unreliable AI disclosure has become for game art.
Dragon Quest creator Yuji Horii says AI 'hardly ever makes things up' anymore, a notable vote of confidence in the tech from one of game design's most influential authors.
Skillprint's Flow turns ordinary gameplay sessions into structured human-performance data for AI systems, positioning games as a measurement layer for player cognition and design tuning.
Five Nordic industry voices explain how AI is reshaping studio culture, creative roles, team structure and legal risk — a ground-level look at AI-native production practice.
Final Fantasy: Crystal Chronicles composer Kumi Tanioka says an AI-generated album was published under her name on Spotify, exposing how weak identity controls are for game creators' catalogues.
Hands-on with DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction: NVIDIA's neural denoiser visibly improves path-traced image quality, but artefacts remain — a status check on AI-driven rendering craft.
Agis unveiled The Platform at Gamescom, a cross-device creation tool for user-generated content where creators retain ownership of what they build.
